name: al-jihad
description: الجهاد — Teacher Management & Private Tutoring Platform (offline-first PWA + Apps Script backend)

scripts.build:web: npm run build:domain && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:portal: npm run build:domain && npm run build --workspace=apps/portal
scripts.build:script: npm run build:domain && npm run build --workspace=apps/script
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/domain && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/portal/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/script
scripts.lint: npm run lint:boundaries && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:portal && npm run build:script
scripts.verify:pwa: node scripts/verify-pwa-assets.mjs apps/web/dist && node scripts/verify-pwa-assets.mjs apps/portal/dist
